name: Solve The Cube
desc:
🧊 Have you ever solved a Rubik's Cube with your LIFE on the line? ⬜

Memorize the key sequence, type it from memory to turn and solve the cube, and beat your rival to it!
Pick NO HINTS to solve a real scrambled cube yourself!

🔴 Set the fastest record! 
🔵 Compete in races with other players! 
🟡 Show us your puzzle skills! 
🟢 Make plans and act quickly! 

Can you solve a Rubik's cube? If so then this game is for you.

⭐ Favorite the game and come back to beat your best time!

Tags:

Cube, Puzzle, Rubiks cube, speedcubing, Solve, Rubiks, Rubik's, typing, memory

llm.loop: memorize key sequence -> type it to turn the cube -> solve faster than rival -> earn wins and coins
llm.objectives: solve the Rubik's cube faster than your opponent and set records
llm.instructions: memorize the key sequence and type it from memory to turn and solve the cube; NO HINTS mode for a real scramble
unique: typing-memory Rubik's cube duels with 'life on the line' stakes
llm.thumbnails: avatars racing to solve cubes with digital timers, 'fastest time wins', winner/loser marks
llm.complexity_notes: cube state logic and duel arena; simple UI
